verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents a consumption-based pricing model with edition tiers and explains that warehouses consume credits you directly control. One hands-on user translated credits and storage into a dollar figure (about $19.60 for 9 credits and 40GB) and noted that credits double with each warehouse size, so the cost drivers are understandable. The pack lacks per-credit or per-TB rates and any estimation tool, and one user reports that auto-clustering costs at scale come with little guidance; resource monitors are spend controls, not estimation aids, and are not credited. Missing for 10: published per-credit and storage price tables in the evidence, a pricing calculator or estimation guide, documented costs for serverless and background features like auto-clustering.
